blocks.title: David Loeffler and Chris Williams
blocks.content:
The Asai (or twisted tensor) L-function of a Bianchi modular form 9 is the L-function attached to the
tensor induction to Q of its associated Galois representation. When 9 is ordinary at p we construct a
p-adic analogue of this L-function: that is, a p-adic measure on Z×
p that interpolates the critical values
of the Asai L-function twisted by Dirichlet characters of p-power conductor. The construction uses
techniques analogous to those used by Lei, Zerbes and the ﬁrst author in order to construct an Euler
system attached to the Asai representation of a quadratic Hilbert modular form.

We establish a Burgess bound for short multiplicative character sums in arbitrary dimensions, in which

character sums evaluated at rational functions, due to the second author.

We propose a conjectural characterization of when the dynamical Galois group associated to a polynomial
is abelian, and we prove our conjecture in several cases, including the stable quadratic case over Q. In the
postcritically inﬁnite case, the proof uses algebraic techniques, including a result concerning ramiﬁcation

together with results of Amoroso and Zannier and Amoroso and Dvornicich, as well as properties of the
Arakelov–Zhang pairing.

blocks.title: Guidelines for Authors
blocks.content:
Authors may submit manuscripts in PDF format on-line at the Submission page at the ANT website.
Originality. Submission of a manuscript acknowledges that the manuscript is original and and is not,
in whole or in part, published or under consideration for publication elsewhere. It is understood also
that the manuscript will not be submitted elsewhere while under consideration for publication in this
journal.
Language. Articles in ANT are usually in English, but articles written in other languages are welcome.
